summary: Adds `_print_Rational` to MpmathPrinter so rationals print as `mpf(p)/mpf(q)`, evaluating at full mpmath working precision and fixing the reduced-precision nsolve problem. Correct, minimal, idiomatic fix matching the printer's existing pattern.

issues.description: Extra blank line before the new method (double blank inside class body) is a slight PEP8/style inconsistency; cosmetic only.

For rationals whose numerator/denominator exceed the current mpf precision, mpf(p)/mpf(q) can still round each operand; acceptable since result is computed at working precision and matches intended behavior, but not exact for pathologically large integers.
